mod.overview: Shifter_v1Y (Yukichigai's 10-24-2007 Beta release, advancing the 11-27-2004 release) adds the Engineer Power-Gun (PowerIt), Ice Shell mode for the Mortar (freezing non-Arbitor players' controls via Shifter_startFreeze), Bouncin' Betty mines (BBMine) for Heavy and DreadNaught armors, dual Standard/Equalizer modes for the Chaingun, a server BuilderMode switch bypassing deployable limits, and unified Weapon::onUse equip messaging.
notes: Unified equip messages (itemmsgs.cs, item.cs Weapon::onUse): individual Weapon::onUse stubs for single-mode weapons were removed from itemmsgs.cs because Weapon::onUse now checks ammo, clears spawn invulnerability ($Shifter::JustSpawned), and prints 'Using <description>' automatically.

Adds $Shifter::IceMortar (enables Mortar mode 4 Ice Shell and Shifter_startFreeze), $Shifter::BuilderMode (bypasses $TeamItemMax checks on HoloPack, TreePack, TeleportPack, MechPack, AirAmmoPad, LaunchPack, AccelPPack, and CoolLauncher), $Shifter::OOBBounce, $Shifter::TurretTrack, and $Shifter::Infiltration.

Ice damage ($IceDamageType 34, damage.cs, player.cs): hits on non-Arbitor players call Shifter_startFreeze, locking the victim's control object and GUI for ~9 seconds (15 s on repeat hits; Chemeleons thaw twice as fast) and clearing burning. Damage scales: Arbitor 0.4, Goliath 1.6, Chemeleon 0.7.

Adds Engineer Power-Gun (PowerIt) to the Engineer tool line alongside Fixit, Hackit, and DisIt; adds BBMine (Bouncin' Betty) for Heavy armor and DreadNaught (%client.dmines == 1); and adds Chaingun Options switching between Standard (JetBullet) and Equalizer (ChaingunBullet) modes.

Launcher wrapper projectiles: MortarImage and MfglImage set FakeMortarShell and FakeFgcShell on the image datablock, whose ::onAdd calls FindProjectileFirer to delegate to MortarImage::onFire / MfglImage::onFire.

Blaster.summary: Starting energy sidearm now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Blaster::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse now prints 'Using Blaster'.

Chaingun.summary: Renamed back to Chaingun with selectable Standard (JetBullet) and Equalizer (ChaingunBullet) firing modes.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Chaingun.description changes from 'Equalizer' to 'Chaingun', ChaingunImage clears projectileType, and ChaingunImage::onFire spawns ChaingunBullet when %client.Chaingun == 1 or JetBullet otherwise.
Chaingun::onUse announces 'Using Chaingun - Equalizer Mode' or 'Using Chaingun - Standard Mode'.
Chaingun.source: item.cs Chaingun, ChaingunImage, ChaingunImage::onFire; itemmsgs.cs Chaingun::onUse; admin.cs

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Grenade Launcher now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, GrenadeLauncher::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Grenade Launcher'.

Mortar.summary: Mortar replacing mode 4 SatchelShell with the remotely detonated Ice Shell and wrapping firing through FakeMortarShell.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, MortarImage sets projectileType FakeMortarShell (whose ::onAdd locates the firer via FindProjectileFirer and runs MortarImage::onFire).

Mode 4 is now Ice Shell (falls back to mode 3 MDM if $Shifter::IceMortar is false): fires IceMortarShell and on second fire detonates IceBlast (20 m $IceDamageType blast that freezes non-Arbitor victims' controls); onUse checks %playerId.firemortar and cleans up $Firer on shell removal.
Mortar.source: item.cs MortarImage, MortarImage::onFire, FakeMortarShell::onAdd; itemmsgs.cs Mortar::onUse; baseProjData.cs IceMortarShell; blasts.cs IceBlast

notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, LaserRifle::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Laser Rifle'.

EnergyRifle.summary: ELF Gun using the shared Weapon::onUse handler and $ArmorName lookup in damageTarget.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, EnergyRifle::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs, and lightningCharge::damageTarget checks $ArmorName[Player::getArmor(%player)] != 'AlArmor' instead of comparing aarmor/afemale directly.

HyperB.summary: Hyper Blaster now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, HyperB::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Hyper Blaster'.

SniperRifle.summary: Sniper Rifle with slightly higher SniperRound damage and shared Weapon::onUse equip handling.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, SniperRound damageValue increases from 0.69 to 0.73 and SniperRifle::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs in favor of Weapon::onUse.

BoomStick.summary: Boom Stick now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, BoomStick::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Boom Stick'.

Silencer.summary: Magnum now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Silencer::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Magnum'.

notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, ConCun::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Shockwave Cannon'.

Railgun.summary: Railgun now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Railgun::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Railgun'.

Vulcan.summary: Vulcan rotary cannon with tighter aim deflection and shared Weapon::onUse equip handling.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, VulcanBullet aimDeflection decreases from 0.007 to 0.005 and Vulcan::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs in favor of Weapon::onUse.

Mfgl.summary: Tactical Nuke launcher routing firing through FakeFgcShell and enforcing the team nuke cap on fire.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, MfglImage sets projectileType FakeFgcShell (whose ::onAdd calls FindProjectileFirer and runs MfglImage::onFire), checks $Nukecount[team] < $Shifter::AllNukeLimit before firing, and spawns an accompanying FgcShell3 linked via $Nuker[%nuker] = %fired with deaddeploy tracking.

Flamer.summary: Flame Thrower now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Flamer::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Flame Thrower'.

IonGun.summary: Ion Rifle now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, IonGun::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Ion Rifle'.

Volter.summary: Volter now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Volter::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Volter'.

TargetingLaser.summary: Targeting Laser now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, TargetingLaser::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Targeting Laser'.

Fixit.summary: Engineer Repair-Gun now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Fixit::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Engineer Repair-Gun'.

RegenerationPack.summary: Regeneration Pack / Gun halving self-heal rate and cleaning up station power shutoff.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, DrainBolt::checkDone heals the user by %damage / 30 (calling both GameBase::repairDamage and setting damageLevel) instead of / 15, and uses StopTempPower(%target) when temporary station power expires.

LightningPack.summary: Teleport Pack fixing the waypoint LOS probe object variable.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, LightningPackImage::onActivate passes %dpos instead of the uninitialized %zpos to GameBase::setPosition and GameBase::getLOSInfo during mode 1 waypoint validation.

HoloPack.summary: Hologram pack bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, HoloPack::onDeploy allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

TreePack.summary: Mechanical Tree pack bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, TreePack::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

TeleportPack.summary: Teleport Pad pack bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, TeleportPack::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

MechPack.summary: Interceptor Pack bypassing the ScoutVehicle team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, MechPack::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

MineAmmo.summary: Mine thrower adding Bouncin' Betty (BBMine) for Heavy and DreadNaught armors and removing Engineer laser-mine restrictions.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Heavy armor (harmor) throws BBMine, DreadNaught (darmor) throws BBMine when %playerId.dmines == '1' (otherwise LaserMine), and Engineer EngMine 2 always calls LaserMine without Deathmatch/possession exemptions.
When a BBMine is destroyed or triggered, BBMine::onDestroyed launches a BBShell upward (0 0 25, 0.35 mine damage in a 20 m radius).

Beacon.summary: Beacon ability slot refusing use while standing in a station.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Beacon::onUse checks '%player.Station == ""' alongside $matchStarted, and Mercenary speed boosts store %ClientId.tacklevec.

AirAmmoPad.summary: Air Ammo Pad bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, AirAmmoPad::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

LaunchPack.summary: Launch Pad pack deployable on StaticShapes and bypassing the team limit in BuilderMode.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, LaunchPack::deployShape allows deployment on StaticShape objects in addition to terrain/interiors, and skips the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

AccelPPack.summary: Accelerator Pad pack bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, AccelPPack::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

Hackit.summary: Engineer Hack-Gun now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Hackit::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Engineer Hack-Gun'.

DisIt.summary: Engineer Disassembler-Gun now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, DisIt::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Engineer Disassymbler-Gun'.

Regen.summary: Regeneration Gun sharing the halved self-heal rate and StopTempPower shutoff from RegenerationPack.
notes: Same DrainBolt::checkDone changes noted under RegenerationPack (/ 30 self-heal and StopTempPower).

CoolLauncher.summary: Missile Control Station bypassing the team limit when $Shifter::BuilderMode is enabled.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, CoolLauncher::deployShape allows deployment if $Shifter::BuilderMode is true.

DetBug.summary: Det Bug allowing collision pickup even when the dropped item's team is -1.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, DetBug::onCollision removes the 'GameBase::getTeam(%this) != -1' guard so neutral-tagged dropped Det Bugs can trigger on players.

LasCannon.summary: Gattling Laser Cannon now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, LasCannon::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Gattling Laser Cannon'.

TranqGun2.summary: Flare Rifle stand-in item updated to use the bulletExp4 explosion effect.
notes: Stat-only change from the 2004-11-27 release: FlareDart explosionTag changed from bulletExp2 to bulletExp4.

MegaDiscLauncher.summary: Unused Mega-Disc Launcher with its itemmsgs.cs stub removed.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, MegaDiscLauncher::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; still has zero ItemMax on all armors.

Boomer.summary: Arbitor energy shotgun now using the shared Weapon::onUse equip handler.
notes: Unlike the 2004-11-27 release, Boomer::onUse was removed from itemmsgs.cs; Weapon::onUse prints 'Using Boomer'.

PowerIt.summary: New Engineer Power-Gun tool that drains the Engineer's energy to temporarily power an unpowered friendly base station.
notes: Carried only by Engineer (earmor/efemale). PowerBolt::onAcquire checks for a friendly unpowered InventoryStation, CommandStation, or AmmoStation (shapeFiles inventory_sta, cmdpnl, ammounit) and starts a 5-second charge.
After 5 seconds, PowerBolt::checkDone empties the Engineer's energy and powers the station for 2 * (energy / rechargeRate) seconds via StopTempPower.
PowerIt.source: item.cs PowerIt, PowerItImage; baseProjData.cs PowerBolt, PowerBolt::onAcquire/checkDone/onRelease, StopTempPower; ArmorData.cs
